arm_definitions.baseline: Schema-derived minimum dependency vector generated deterministically from application semantics.
arm_definitions.superset: Conservative superset: minimum dependency vector plus valid additional entity dependencies.
arm_definitions.global_fallback: Profile-global fallback: minimum dependency vector plus all entity keys within domain.
arm_definitions.mutant: Mutated dependency vectors covering 9 threat model classes (M1-M9).

mutation_categories.M1_omit_entity: Omit one true entity dependency (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M2_add_irrelevant: Add an irrelevant entity dependency (conservative superset, must accept)
mutation_categories.M3_mutate_entity_key: Corrupt semantic key of entity dependency (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M4_mutate_access_mode: Flip access mode READ <-> WRITE on entity dependency (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M5_mutate_version: Increment observed version by +1 claiming stale data is fresh (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M6_write_skew: Omit second write entity from multi-entity write set (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M7_unrelated_replace: Replace entity dependency with entity from different domain (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M8_omit_evidence: Omit required evidence dependency (UNSAFE, must reject)
mutation_categories.M9_omit_governance: Omit required policy/governance dependency (UNSAFE, must reject)

primary_analysis.endpoint: Primary: Zero unsafe commits (invalid/corrupted dependency vectors accepted) and zero false-stale aborts across schema-derived baseline and conservative superset vectors.
primary_analysis.fail_closed_criteria: Any single unsafe commit or false-stale abort is a contract failure requiring code remediation.
